name: language-srs
description: Exam-aligned spaced repetition for Mandarin, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese, with home-screen widgets. Runs on web, iOS and Android from one codebase.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @language-srs/core && npm run test --workspace @language-srs/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @language-srs/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @language-srs/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @language-srs/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @language-srs/mobile
